app.name: RiftWii Channel Installer
app.short_description: Adds RiftWii to the Wii Menu
app.long_description:
Puts a RiftWii channel on the Wii Menu, updates it or removes it. The channel holds no copy of RiftWii: it starts apps/riftwii/boot.dol from the SD card (or the USB drive), so RiftWii's own updates never need it installed again.
RiftWii's Settings opens this installer too, and it goes back to RiftWii when it closes.
Needs a d2x cIOS in slot 249, 250 or 251. Free software under the GPL, version 3 or later.
